from typing import List

def cocktail_shaker_sort(arr: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    n = len(arr)
    if n <= 1:
        return arr
    
    is_sorted = False
    start = 0
    end = n - 1
    
    while not is_sorted:
        is_sorted = True
        
        # Forward pass
        for i in range(start, end):
            if arr[i] > arr[i + 1]:
                arr[i], arr[i + 1] = arr[i + 1], arr[i]
                is_sorted = False
        
        if is_sorted:
            break
        
        is_sorted = True
        end -= 1
        
        # Backward pass
        for i in range(end, start, -1):
            if arr[i] < arr[i - 1]:
                arr[i], arr[i - 1] = arr[i - 1], arr[i]
                is_sorted = False
        
        start += 1
    
    return arr
